components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--accent, oklch(0.45 0.16 268)); color: var(--button-text, oklch(0.985 0.002 265)); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, oklch(0.45 0.16 268)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The system pairs the writer's ink with the engineer's instrument. Every surface is cool paper carrying blue-black ink; every accent is one archival blue; every structural line is a hairline drawn with intent. The engineering is expressed through precision — exact alignment, weighted line-work in real technical drawings, tabular numbers — never through costume. If an element pretends to be a physical document artifact rather than simply being well-made, it is off-system.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper, never warm cream; midnight desk (dark) first-load default, cool paper on the toggle
One accent (Iron-Gall Blue) doing every colored job on the page
Serif-led voice (Literata) framed by machined UI (Archivo); mono quarantined inside figures
Hairline rules and sharp corners; flat surfaces; depth by tint, not shadow
Two living line drawings as personality anchors, ambient and reduced-motion-safe

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Iron-Gall Blue is the only chromatic voice, on ≤10% of any screen. If a second hue appears anywhere outside a photograph, it is a bug. The retired red must not return.

rules.name: The Quarantined Mono Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono may appear only inside a drawing, where a technical annotation is authentic. Mono as UI chrome is forbidden.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif (Literata) speaks only where prose lives: headline, body paragraphs, quoted questions, captions. Every label, section title, value, and navigation row is Archivo, roman, normal case. Italic serif used as a label is the AI-editorial fingerprint; forbidden here.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If an element casts a shadow, it is off-system. Separation is drawn (hairlines) or tinted (paper steps), never floated.

dos: Do keep midnight desk (dark) as the first-load default; cool paper is the toggle.
Do spend Iron-Gall Blue only on: primary CTA, links/hovers, active nav, figure annotations, status labels, Contents numbers.
Do draw separations with hairlines and keep every corner sharp (0px).
Do keep both drawings alive (traveling dashes, breathing ring) and complete without JavaScript.
Do hold text contrast: body ≥ Ink Secondary, captions ≥ Ink Tertiary (5.5:1 floor).
donts: Don't reintroduce costume props: report stamps, REV numbers, ABSTRACT labels, 'Fig.' prefixes, or any document-larp detail.

Don't use the PRODUCT.md anti-reference aesthetics: LinkedIn / generic student portfolio, bright SaaS marketing, AI-template aesthetics (cream-and-serif defaults, eyebrow labels, glassmorphism), sci-fi / space kitsch.
Don't warm the paper — the body background never enters the cream band; it stays cool toward the ink hue.
Don't use mono outside a figure, tracked-uppercase eyebrows, side-stripe borders, gradient text, or box-shadows.
Don't bring back the red. One ink.
